protocol.target: single masked token with post-MLM evidence filtering
protocol.physical_constraints: visible Hebrew outside brackets; editor-derived length is a separate oracle condition
protocol.primary_unit: one target; any compatible attributed restoration
protocol.interpretation: agreement with attributed literature; visible traces are transcription-encoded, and length is editor-derived rather than independent physical ground truth

rag.score: MLM logit + alpha * exact-context retrieval score

weight_fit.trace_shapes: QD visible-letter counts and anchor flags; no QD readings

soft_trace.score: MLM logit minus alpha times graded trace disagreement

condition_definitions.context_only: MLM ranking without trace or length filtering
condition_definitions.soft_visible: development-tuned graded trace compatibility; no candidate is discarded
condition_definitions.editor_length_only: editor-derived display/initial word length with tolerance
condition_definitions.visible_plus_editor_length: visible traces plus editor-derived length; not P0
condition_definitions.frequency_visible_only: training-corpus frequency lexicon filtered by visible traces
condition_definitions.frequency_visible_plus_editor_length: frequency lexicon with visible traces and editor-derived length
condition_definitions.retrieval_visible_only: non-neural exact-context retrieval backed off by frequency, then trace-filtered

composition_unseen_subset.definition: held-out scroll whose non-empty composition labels do not occur in train or dev

visible_trace_confidence.interpretation: agreement with incomplete attributed proposals, not truth calibration
